verdict.rationale: Airweave documents search, MCP, CLI, and connector integrations, but there is no mention anywhere of LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs, or any real-time voice pipeline integration, nor any discussion of latency suitability for live conversation beyond generic search speed claims. This is an applicable axis for a memory/search SDK (voice agent frameworks are a plausible integration target) but no evidence supports it.
